campaigns.description: Partially updates a campaign using the Rest.li PARTIAL_UPDATE pattern: the body wraps the fields to change in patch.$set. fields.name: id
fields.description: Numerical identifier for the form.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the Lead Form provided by the owner.

fields.name: owner
fields.description:
URN that identifies the owner of the Lead Form.
It's a Union of sponsoredAccount and organization.
sponsoredAccount is an URN of SponsoredAccountUrn that indicates the account of the advertiser.
organization is an URN of OrganizationUrn that indicates the company account of the marketer.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Information about the current state of the Lead Form.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Content of the Lead Form which will be displayed to the viewer.

fields.name: created
fields.description: An epoch time corresponding to the creation of the form.

fields.name: lastModified
fields.description: An epoch time corresponding to the last modified of of the form.

fields.name: creationLocale
fields.description:
Locale of the entity.
This field serves as the preferred locale for all fields within the Lead Form with an object type that is capable of localization, such as MultiLocaleString.

fields.name: hiddenFields
fields.description:
Hidden fields used by the owner to track key attributes of the form that generated the lead.
The field is empty if the owner chooses to not append any tracking attributes to the Lead Form.

fields.name: reviewInfo
fields.description:
Latest information about the content review of the Lead Form.
It will not be present if the form has not been reviewed by the review pipeline.

fields.name: versionId
fields.description: The version ID of the form. This is a derived field and is generated on the server side.

fields.name: versionTag
fields.description: The number of times the form has been modified.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique id to identify the Lead Form Response.

fields.name: leadType
fields.description: Type of the lead representing the origination of the lead.

fields.name: form
fields.description: URN identifying which form this FormResponse belongs to.

fields.name: owner
fields.description:
Owner of this Lead Form Response.
It is a Union of sponsoredAccount and organization.
sponsoredAccount is an URN of SponsoredAccountUrn that indicates the ad account of the advertiser.
organization is an URN of OrganizationUrn that indicates the company page of the advertiser.

fields.name: ownerInfo
fields.description: Record containing entity info that owns this Lead Form Response. It's a optional Union of sponsoredAccountInfo and organizationInfo.

fields.name: leadMetadata
fields.description: Metadata of a lead. This field is optional for test leads and other use cases where sponsored lead metadata (e.g. campaign) may not be relevant. If there is no value, the field is not returned.

fields.name: leadMetadataInfo
fields.description: Record containing a subset of fields resolved on demand from the lead metadata references (e.g. campaign name , campaign type). If there is no value, an empty object is returned.

fields.name: associatedEntity
fields.description: URN identifying which entity the lead is associated with. This field is optional for test leads and other use cases where leads don't have any associatedEntity. If there is no value, the field is not returned.

fields.name: associatedEntityInfo
fields.description: Record containing useful fields (creative status, ugc reference etc.) resolved on demand from the associated entity object. If there is no value, an empty object is returned.

fields.name: submittedAt
fields.description: An epoch timestamp that recording when the form response was submitted.

fields.name: responseId
fields.description: The unique identifier for the form response generated in the front-end when a submitter submits the response.

fields.name: formResponse
fields.description: Answers provided by the form submitter.

fields.name: testLead
fields.description: Whether this is a test lead created for testing purposes.

fields.name: submitter
fields.description:
From version 202408 onwards, Guest Leads (when a user submits a form without being logged in) submitted to lead forms, submitter field is treated as a null field and omitted from the JSON response.
For non-guest leads, the submitter field will still be included in the response and will provide the person's URN. Ex: "submitter": "urn:li:person:MpGcnvaU_p".	Yes

fields.name: versionedLeadGenFormUrn
fields.description: URN identifying which form this FormResponse belongs to.
